comment: dog.c tamedog() 1230: a debug Wizard with a starting kitten (mtame 10) unwields, punches the kitten once bare-handed (uhitm.c 1595 abuse_dog(): mtame 9), waits until it is adjacent again, then reads a wished blessed scroll of taming. The already-tame kitten with mtame below 10 may gain 1, then the blessed scroll adds 2, so mtame exceeds 10 and is clamped to 10.
